parent_objective: audit bounded source traces before measured candidate materialization
blocked_by: trace quality and candidate eligibility must be audited before materialization
supersedes: direct candidate materialization from first runner smoke without audit

public_gates: M1512 must audit M1511 trace quality and guardrails
M1512 must summarize source-family reachability terminal patterns labels and margins
M1512 must decide whether measured candidate materialization is admissible
M1512 must not train run PPO promote use private holdout alter actor inputs or export corpus
M1512 must not claim self-identification from trace reachability alone
forbidden_shortcuts: do not materialize candidates during the audit
do not claim self-identification from bounded runner success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M1511 bounded source traces before deciding whether candidate materialization is admissible
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: trace-quality audit and next-route decision only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if M1511 guardrails were violated
stop if trace artifacts are missing or malformed
stop if source traces cannot support reveal decision and post-decision windows
stop if audit would need private holdout or corpus export
fallback_plan: if traces are malformed, route to runner repair
if labels or margins are uninformative, route to env-hook/source-family retargeting
if trace quality is sufficient, route to measured candidate materialization design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1511 produced bounded source trace artifacts

admission_evidence: M1511 source traces reached reveal decision and post-decision windows for all six source families with guardrails false
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up candidate materialization or repair manifest
next_stage_criteria: negative evidence and limitations are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1512 audits trace plumbing only; reachability cannot distinguish history necessity from current-frame control.
history_necessity_tests: audit whether M1511 traces preserve windows that could later support T4/T5 history interventions
do not claim history necessity until wrong/delayed/current-tiled intervention margins are measured
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1511 bounded fixed-policy source traces only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If trace quality is insufficient, route to runner or env-hook repair and record the reason instead of materializing weak candidates.
allowed_claims: M1512 audits bounded source trace quality
no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1511 bounded runner artifacts are complete enough to audit whether measured candidate materialization should proceed.
success_criteria: audit summarizes trace reachability terminal patterns labels and margin ranges
audit explicitly decides materialization-admit repair or stop
audit keeps training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input change corpus export and self-ID claims blocked
failure_criteria: audit treats trace reachability as self-ID evidence
audit starts candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout or corpus export
decision_rule: M1512 passes if it audits bounded runner trace quality and selects the next route without materializing candidates or claiming self-identification.
